title: STNFS with a ball-region sieved descent: 2^123.5

claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-fixed-g2-invert-g1 challenge, the STNFS algorithm of proof.md recovers P in G1 with e(P,Q)=z for the exact supplied nonidentity Q (P=infinity for z=1) with success at least 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh coins (modelled 0.725: main phase >= 0.9, both boots fail with probability <= 1.82e-2, Markov bound 2^-2.50 at the 2^121-unit descent cap), under the NFS heuristics H1-H5 of proof.md section 9. A global meter bounds all classical work, including preprocessing, failures, transfers, verification and output, by W <= 2^123.5 dense-Fp12-multiplication units at C=20,000 instructions; the ledger totals 2^123.092838 (relation collection 2^122.1826, linear algebra 2^121.9943, descent cap 2^121 with expected two-log work 2^118.496). Distributed storage is at most 2^93 bytes in bounded, explicitly addressed objects. Nothing is amortized across challenges; no advice or auxiliary powers are used. This is an analytic exploratory claim, not a full-size run.

experiments.purpose: Stdlib-only, credential-free recomputation of the field certificates, Dickman rho, pool, yield/cost ledger, filtering, the descent plan, toy descents and the production audit.
